core_features.name: Freelancer & Vendor Directory
core_features.description: Single searchable registry for freelancers and vendors with CRUD fields: name, email, role/type, status, hourly rate, currency, start/end dates, and compliance flags.

core_features.name: Onboarding Tracker
core_features.description: Checklist-based onboarding per freelancer/vendor (contract signed, tax form received, NDA complete, payment method set) with completion percentage and status transitions.

core_features.name: Project Assignment & Costing
core_features.description: Assign freelancers to projects with bill rate, estimated hours, and date range; auto-calculate planned cost per assignment and aggregate per project.

core_features.name: Budget Dashboard
core_features.description: View budget vs. planned spend vs. actual paid amount by project and by month, with over-budget highlighting for quick operational decisions.

core_features.name: Budget Reporting API Export
core_features.description: Generate JSON/CSV-ready budget report payloads from an API endpoint for external accounting tools or manual downloads.

acceptance_criteria: User can create, edit, view, and archive freelancer records via UI and REST endpoints.
User can create, edit, view, and archive vendor records via UI and REST endpoints.
Each freelancer/vendor has an onboarding checklist whose item states persist in the database.
User can assign a freelancer to a project with rate and hours, and planned cost is calculated correctly.
Dashboard shows total planned spend, total actual paid, and remaining budget for current month.
Budget report endpoint returns project-level totals and monthly rollups in JSON.
All write endpoints validate payloads with Zod and return consistent error responses.
Prototype runs locally with SQLite and seeded sample data in under 5 minutes of setup.
